strings.text: A Pier on a Mountain Lake
The water went still before the light went out.
strings.translation: Вода затихла раньше, чем погас свет.

strings.text: The last light is slipping behind the ridge.
The lantern was lit a little earlier than it needed to be.
strings.translation: Фонарь зажгли чуть раньше, чем было нужно.

strings.text: The boat quietly tugs at its rope and goes still again.
strings.translation: Лодка тихо трогает верёвку и снова замирает.
